title: Director of Operations (PCNY - Queens)
text:
**ABOUT US:** 
With a dedication to our people and our products, The Honickman Companies® are collectively one of the largest independent beverage employers in the country. Our Pepsi business includes distribution for brands like Pepsi-Cola, Starbucks, Lipton Teas, Gatorade, Evian and more, throughout the 5 Borough’s, Long Island, Westchester and Pennsauken NJ. If you are excited to work with some of the biggest brands in the world, in the biggest brand market in the world, come see what we have to offer. a passionate, self-motivated, and detail-oriented team player who is committed to the success of our customers. You will focus on growing and developing existing clients, as well as generating new business by identifying, implementing and executing new strategies.
 
 
**SUMMARY:** 
Leads the day-to-day operations of a large-scale beverage manufacturing facility, with overall accountability for Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing. Establishes operating priorities and develops leaders and teams to deliver safe, high-quality, cost-effective and efficient production. Applies practical business judgment, disciplined execution and continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System to improve plant performance and support the Company’s business strategy.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 

* Provides visible, hands-on leadership and direction for all plant operations, including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing.
* Establishes clear operating priorities, performance expectations and accountability; aligns staffing, resources and production plans with customer and business requirements.
* Ensures production schedules are achieved while meeting safety, food safety, quality, efficiency, cost and customer service expectations.
* Monitors and acts upon key performance indicators, including safety performance, schedule attainment, production efficiency, equipment utilization, downtime, waste, labor productivity, inventory accuracy and service levels.
* Identifies operating constraints and performance gaps; leads root cause analysis, corrective actions and practical solutions that improve throughput, reliability and execution.
* Ensures manufacturing processes, standard operating procedures and controls are documented, consistently followed and improved as business needs evolve.
* Partners with Quality leadership to maintain effective food safety, sanitation, preventive control and quality systems and to resolve customer complaints, audit findings and corrective actions promptly.
* Provides leadership and oversight for preventive and predictive maintenance, work-order execution and equipment reliability; aligns maintenance priorities with production requirements and long-term asset needs.
* Supports capital planning and execution, including equipment upgrades, facility improvements and other investments that improve safety, capacity, reliability or cost performance.
* Oversees warehouse, inventory control, shipping and receiving operations to ensure accurate inventory, efficient material flow, appropriate space utilization and timely customer shipments.
* Drives practical, results-oriented continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System; ensures initiatives produce measurable gains in safety, quality, productivity, waste, cost and equipment effectiveness.
* Develops and manages operating plans and budgets; controls labor, overtime, waste, operating expense and other key financial measures while balancing service and production needs.
* Leads, develops and holds department managers and supervisors accountable; builds leadership capability, cross-functional collaboration and a strong succession pipeline.
* Builds a culture of teamwork, communication, employee engagement and ownership by maintaining a regular presence on the plant floor and engaging employees at all levels.
* Establishes productive relationships with employees and union representatives; ensures consistent application of Company policies, procedures and applicable collective bargaining agreements and addresses employee relations matters promptly and professionally.
* Promotes a proactive safety culture and ensures compliance with applicable OSHA, environmental, food safety, regulatory and customer requirements; directs timely incident investigations and corrective actions.
* Provides accurate and timely operating reports, communicates plant performance and risks, and recommends actions needed to achieve business objectives.
* Performs other related duties as required and assigned

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:** 
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 

* Comprehensive knowledge of large-scale manufacturing operations, production planning, equipment reliability, quality systems, food safety, warehousing, distribution and inventory controls.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to develop operating plans, manage budgets and labor costs, interpret performance data and translate findings into action.
* Practical knowledge of continuous improvement, root cause analysis, standard work and performance management; ability to implement solutions that deliver measurable operational results.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a complex operation through multiple levels of management and to establish priorities, accountability and disciplined execution across functions.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental and food-manufacturing regulatory requirements and the ability to maintain effective safety, quality and compliance systems.
* Proven ability to lead and develop managers and supervisors, engage a diverse hourly workforce and build effective labor-management relationships in a union environment.
* Excellent judgment, problem-solving, organizational and follow-up skills; able to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a fast-paced operation.
* Effective oral, written and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate expectations, performance, risks and recommendations to employees, leaders and senior management.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; familiarity with manufacturing, maintenance, warehouse and performance-reporting systems.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including prior overall responsibility as a plant, site or operations leader for a large, complex manufacturing facility.
* Prior responsibility for multiple functions, including Production, Quality, Maintenance and Warehouse/Distribution operations, with demonstrated success improving plant performance.
* Beverage manufacturing experience strongly preferred; significant food manufacturing experience will also be considered.
* Experience leading a unionized manufacturing workforce strongly preferred.
* Experience managing operating budgets, labor costs, productivity, equipment reliability, quality, safety and overall plant performance required.
* Any equivalent combination of education, experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS / WORK ENVIRONMENT / TRAVEL:** 

* Manufacturing, warehouse and office environments; regular presence on the production floor is required.
* Must be able to work around moving equipment, elevated noise levels, temperature variation and other conditions typical of a beverage manufacturing facility, with required personal protective equipment.
* Ability to move throughout the facility and occasionally lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule and respond to operational needs outside normal business hours; limited travel may be required.

**COMPENSATION RANGE:** 
Potential earning is from $190,000.00 - $215,000.00 annually
 
 
The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required by personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the company.
 
 

* We do not provide application status due to overwhelming volume. If your skills meet our needs, we will contact you to move forward in the process.\*
